description: Reviewed old-to-new paths. The source/test baseline is never regenerated after a move.

AR-B1.reason: Flatten Device Home without API/schema/transaction changes. Empty package markers collapse into the existing domain package.
AR-B1.removed_abstractions: Two one-method use-case classes and the solely SQLAlchemy-backed Protocol are represented by service functions and the concrete repository; no remaining legacy import consumers.

AR-F1.reason: Move Device Home feature implementation, screen composition, and minimum shared dependencies to the documented layout without changing DOM, requests or runtime contracts.
AR-F1.compatibility: Legacy shared modules re-export canonical common implementations. Device Home public.ts temporarily exports API/types/presentation only for four exact unmigrated consumers.

AR-B2-identity.status: IMPLEMENTED; focused behavior/guard/public node checks PASS; source capture, integrated validation, PR and merge pending
AR-B2-identity.scope: PARTIAL: all new identity role modules are active, while exact identity.public ORM/type compatibility consumers remain until their own stages and AR-B8-A. No migrated identity code imports public or legacy services.
AR-B2-identity.account_deletion: Identity service admits the request; main and public_main install the same runtime callable, dependencies resolve it, and service passes the caller Session/user unchanged. Runtime owns one commit/rollback and media restore/purge. Both factory bindings are G06 preservation contracts.
AR-B2-identity.local_owner: SqlAlchemyIdentityRepository was the policy/transaction implementation. It becomes LocalIdentityService with optional clock/explicit now; five forwarding wrappers and the unused repository Protocol retire without altering failed-attempt commit behavior.
AR-B2-identity.shared_dependencies: app.api.identity_dependencies re-exports the identical HTTP dependency callables/browser module for other routers. SDK I/O lives in integrations/google_identity and integrations/bounded_http; startup security composition lives in runtime/startup_security.
AR-B2-identity.bootstrap_projection: LocalIdentityService._owner_candidates reads only owner-scoped counts from characters, active world_memberships and llm_credentials in the same Session. It does not write foreign tables; this bounded bootstrap projection is preserved explicitly.
AR-B2-identity.public_bridge_retirement: AR-B2 character/world/model consumers, AR-B3 package consumers, AR-B4 routine consumers and AR-B6 chat consumers move to supported service/schema/contract; final closure and complete identity domain scope at AR-B8-A. Aggregate model aliases retire with AR-G5.

backend/app/domains/identity/ports/ident: IdentityRepository: no separate repository consumer/fake implementation; explicit now and clock remain injectable on the service

test_ownership.mixed_tests_remain: M3 privacy/account deletion, SQLite/runtime, Memory batch and Device Home keep their mixed owner paths and receive actual import/workflow changes only.
